interpretation: Positive specificity means post-editing moves text toward the author's OWN control style more than toward other authors' styles (not generic humanisation). If edit features predict own_gain better than other_gain, the restored style is author-specific. NOTE: the 'edit features + other_gain' model includes other_gain as a predictor, so its R^2 answers a different question (how much author-specific signal is left once the generic component is accounted for) and is NOT directly comparable to the edit-features-only R^2 values above.
